PureThink: the LICENSOR (Neo4j) appended the Commons Clause to the AGPL; the court rejected the argument that licensees could strip it out under AGPL §7/§10, because those sections restrict "you" (the licensee), not the licensor. 9th Cir. unpublished, non-precedential memorandum (Feb. 18, 2022).
